## ff76baf6c2d9

**Reproduced teaching shortcut.** Generator SHA-256 `2a34c30b086a28f6f71b5743cff1203d73c7528e0dc1f5658476f421b0b7c80c`, canonical rule hash `d31dc299f026`.

The generated `easy` lesson at seed `800009`, sample indices `36,37,38,39`, is lawful under the target's own `self_check`. Samples 36–38 contain no source whose unique anchor color is 2, so the rival “copy every requested template without horizontal mirroring” matches all three canonical Racket outputs. Sample 39 introduces a color-2 request; the intended rule mirrors it and the rival differs in two cells. Thus the query requires an exception not evidenced by any demonstration.

The complete four-input lesson, Racket outputs, rival outputs, exact differences, hashes, validator status, and reproduction command are in `checks/audit/ff76baf6c2d9/counterexample.json`; supported Racket receipt: `checks/audit/ff76baf6c2d9/racket.json`. The broader deterministic scan found this pattern in 59/1,000 easy, 32/1,000 medium, and 17/1,000 hard windows using the same three-demo/one-query schedule; those rates are diagnostic, not an exhaustive distribution estimate.

The read-only official audit battery also failed semantic contract and active authority synchronization, while lint, self-check, rule smoke, profile floor, diversity, override, grammar, and Racket lint passed. Evidence: `checks/audit/ff76baf6c2d9/battery/checks/ff76baf6c2d9_after_battery_summary.json`. No audit target files were modified.

## ff76baf6c2d9

**Reproduced teaching shortcut.** Generator SHA-256 `2a34c30b086a28f6f71b5743cff1203d73c7528e0dc1f5658476f421b0b7c80c`; executed canonical rule hash `d31dc299f026`.

The current source reproduces the prior review-index lead independently. With seed `800009`, difficulty `easy`, and consecutive sample indices `36,37,38,39`, all four inputs pass the target’s `self_check`. For samples 36–38, the rival “copy every requested template without the special horizontal reflection for anchor color 2” exactly matches the canonical Racket output. Sample 39 introduces the needed color-2 distinction: the authority and rival differ at exactly two cells, `(4,8)` and `(4,10)`. Thus three demonstrations support the simpler rival while the query requires an undemonstrated exception.

The complete grids, authority labels, rival labels, hashes, exact differences, and supported-runner command are in `checks/audit/ff76baf6c2d9/counterexample.json`; the unmodified canonical runner receipt is `checks/audit/ff76baf6c2d9/racket.json`. A deterministic diagnostic scan of 1,000 overlapping four-sample windows per band with the same seed found the same query-only branch pattern in 53 easy, 44 medium, and 24 hard windows. Those rates use the task mirror for scanning and are diagnostic, not an exhaustive distribution estimate; the retained counterexample itself is Racket-labeled.

An optional full audit battery was also started read-only. Its outer command window ended during `defect_lint` after `lint`, `selfcheck`, and `rule_smoke` were green, so `checks/audit/ff76baf6c2d9/battery/` is retained as incomplete evidence and is not used to claim a battery verdict. No audit target file was modified.
